metrics.description: Binary metric: 1.0 if the report correctly identifies the flawed register without false positives on benign registers, 0.0 otherwise.

acceptance_criteria: The submitted 'leakage_type' describes a first-order switching or glitch-based leakage.
hidden_spec.ground_truth: The labeled recombine_xor net and recombined_sbox_q register depend directly on the unmasked S-box value; isolated share registers are not primary first-order leakage points.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted 'recombination_net' field exactly matches the ground truth net name.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must correctly identify the recombine_xor net as the primary first-order leakage point.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Check if the submitted 'recombination_register' field exactly matches the ground truth register name.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must correctly identify the recombined_sbox_q register as the storage element capturing the recombined value.

security_requirements.detection_strategy: Verify that the submitted identifiers do not correspond to any of the benign share registers.
security_requirements.requirement: The analysis must not flag any isolated share registers as primary leakage points.

hidden_spec.threat_model: A power observer exploits glitches or transitions where both shares meet to recover the unmasked sensitive intermediate.

constraints: The RTL implements a first-order masked S-box with two random shares and registered nonlinear processing.
The design includes benign share registers and one flawed recombination register.
The leakage model is Hamming-distance based.

functional_requirements.requirement: The submitted vulnerability_report.json must be valid JSON and parseable by a standard JSON parser.
The report must contain the three required fields: "recombination_net", "recombination_register", and "leakage_type", each with a non-empty string value.
The values for "recombination_net" and "recombination_register" must be valid hierarchical identifiers present in the provided RTL netlist.

public_spec.interface: The participant must submit a single JSON file at submission/vulnerability_report.json. The file must contain an object with the following required fields: "recombination_net" (string, the exact hierarchical name of the net where shares recombine), "recombination_register" (string, the exact hierarchical name of the register that captures the recombined value), and "leakage_type" (string, a brief description of the leakage mechanism, e.g., "first-order switching leakage").
public_spec.objective: Analyze the provided masked S-box RTL and identify the exact net and register where two individually masked shares are recombined in a single cycle, creating a first-order switching leakage point.

title: Recombination flaw in a first-order masked S-box
